items.Description: A set of picks, cutters, drills, and fasteners, popular with rogues.

items.Name: Quill Pen Case
items.Description: A quill pen case made of gold, held shut by a clasp. Carved into the top of the case is a scene of a scribe sitting on a stool amid stacks of parchment, writing in a tome.  The symbol of Deneir, a lit candle above an eye, is engraved on the opposite side.

items.Name: Golden Earring
items.Description: This gold earring has a spring clamp, and is attached to a chain holding a large, polished, irregular piece of clear sapphire.

items.Name: Chain
items.Description: A long chain made of ornamental, gold-plated, triple interlaced links, which are both heavy and strong.

items.Name: Chatelaine
items.Description: A rotting leather-and-silk belt pouch, containing gold-plated scissors, gold-plated thimble, ivory needles, brass keyring, and various bits of leather and cloth.

items.Name: Silver Coffer
items.Description: A chased silver box, depicting wooded scenes with birds in branches on the back and sides.  The top is graced by an engraving of a maiden combing her hair, while looking into a pool at her reflection.

items.Name: Medallion
items.Description: An electrum medallion inlaid with copper in the design of a phoenix rising from flames.

items.Name: Oak Staff
items.Description: A fire-blackened oak staff, shod with meteoritic steel at its base.  The head of the staff is carved into the shape of a fanged serpent, with rubies for eyes.

items.Name: Bracelet
items.Description: A bracelet made of many tiny pearls, strung together on gilded wire, fastened with a hook and loop clasp.

items.Name: Skullcap
items.Description: An ornamental skullcap of beaten gold, cut in the shape of floral vines meeting, curling away, then meeting again.

items.Name: Golden Cup
items.Description: A cup of the thinnest beaten gold, set with a lip-ring of a dozen tiny emeralds. Rings of chased gold encircle the cup in interlocking patterns.

items.Name: Wood-Carved Statue
items.Description: This wooden statue is the work of a master craftsman - it depicts a vivacious and beautiful human female,  sharing a moment of laughter with an unseen other.
PropertiesDecoded: Greater Vigor (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Ornamental Bell
items.Description: A clappered bell made of polished rose crystal.  The bell and clapper are joined by fine gold wire.

items.Name: Candelabra
items.Description: A heavy candelabra made of solid silver, nearly black with tarnish.  Four stepped branches curl up into open silver flowers, fashioned to hold candles.

items.Name: Golden Bangles
items.Description: A pair of gold hoops with rounded edges, suitable to be worn on the wrists or biceps.

items.Name: Golden Ball
items.Description: A solid golden sphere, dimpled from use but still brightly polished.

items.Name: Statuette
items.Description: An ivory statuette, depicting an armored human warrior leaning upon a greatsword.

items.Name: Garter
items.Description: A garter consisting of nine gold coins linked with gold wire, from which hangs an electrum mesh fringe extending down in six triangles.  At the bottom of each triangle is a claw-mounted, smoothly polished jacinth.  The whole garter is backed with a worn black leather band.

items.Name: Salt Cellar
items.Description: A salt cellar made of ornately carved gold, sealed with a cork stopper.  The cellar is shaped like a slumbering dragon, curled around a pile of gold.

items.Name: Sword Hilt
items.Description: A sword hilt made of intricately carved gold, with an enameled painting of a hawk in flight at the center of the grip.  The pommel is fashioned into a hawk's head.  The hilt is probably ornamental in nature, as solid gold is seldom sturdy enough to stand up to combat.

items.Name: Crystal Flagon
items.Description: This flagon is carved from clear rock crystal, and is polished glass-smooth.

items.Name: Beer Stein
items.Description: A heavy pewter beer stein set into a gold-plated iron frame, with gold handle and pierced gold decorative side panels that depict huntsmen in the chase, winding horns, and hunting dogs harrying a stag.

items.Name: Book
items.Description:
This book has steel-edged, beaten gold covers, and is embossed and painted in fine, intricate repeating pattern borders.  The cover depicts a warrior with a longsword battling a dragon, which he is grasping by the throat.

The book, written in Old Thorass, is called A Roll of He…

items.Name: Gorget
items.Description: A moon-shaped neckpiece, made of silver-plated steel.  It is slightly tarnished, missing the strap, and bears a fine engraving in the shape of a star.

items.Name: Hairpin
items.Description: An antique hairpin, gilded and set with a bloodstone gem as the head of the pin.

items.Name: Drinking Jack
items.Description: A drinking jack of polished black and white horn, with silver cap and base.

items.Name: Keyring
items.Description: A gold-plated keyring.

items.Name: Golden Flute
items.Description: A golden flute, of delicate workmanship and mirror-smooth finish.

items.Name: Golden Urn
items.Description: A golden urn, chased and cut with relief designs of flowers and painted with scarlet blossoms.  It is in excellent condition.

items.Name: Golden Mirror
items.Description: A solid gold globe, cut with a relief of four sylphs amid clouds, framing a highly-polished area of gold that acts as a mirror.  The eyes of the sylphs are made from tiny, cabochon-cut rubies.

items.Name: Golden Crown
items.Description: A crown of yellow gold with six slim spires.  At the base of each skillfully-decorated golden spire is a gem.  Five are large zircon gems, and the tallest spire is inlaid with a huge amethyst. The size and top-heavy balance of this crown make it impractical as a headpiece.

items.Name: Velvet Mask
items.Description: A well-made half-mask of black velvet, backed by shiny leather.  The lower edge is trimmed with tiny teardrop citrines.

items.Name: Anklet
items.Description: This anklet is made of 12 tiny plates of gold, linked with gilded wire and fastened by hook and eye loops.  Each loop hooks around a tiny wire-mounted gem, 11 in all.  There are four white pearls, six violet garnets, and a blue spinel.

items.Name: Gaming Piece
items.Description: An ivory statuette, depicting a cloaked halfling wanderer. It has amazing detail, including tiny beads of amber for eyes.

items.Name: Golden Ring
items.Description: A ring of carved and beaten gold, shaped into curlicue designs that all lead to a mock beast claw holding a large aquamarine gem.

items.Name: Golden Fishhook
items.Description:
A gaudy, ornamental fishhook made of beaten gold and studded with gems. 
This item was crafted by Obed Fisher, for the Esoteric Anglers of Luskan, who used it as a trophy. There are six moonstones, eight amethysts, two red garnets, two pink pearls, two green tourmalines, and six…

items.Name: Door Handle
items.Description: A door handle of steel, plated with gold and fashioned into the form of a curling snake.

items.Name: Bodkin
items.Description: A long sewing needle with a blunt tip, this tempered steel bodkin has a wire twist that loops around a tiny crown-cut carnelian.

items.Name: Jeweled Glove
items.Description: A human-sized, right-handed glove made of leather.  It is stitched with colorful beads and gems, making a curling floral pattern.  There are nine polished rock crystal teardrops, eight white pearls, a pale opal, and a peridot gem.

items.Name: Chamber Pot
items.Description: A copper chamber pot, chased and embossed in a relief design of a rampant forest dragon, featuring emeralds for eyes.

items.Name: Golden Vestments
items.Description: These cloth-of-gold vestments are somewhat frayed and slightly age-stained, but the intricate embroidery has held up pretty well.  The garments are human-sized, with a loose cape, undertunic, bell sleeves, and coins sewn into the fabric.  The coins bear the image of Waukeen, The…

items.Name: Electrum Ring
items.Description: A ring of ornately and skillfully worked electrum, set with two obsidian chips, which form the eyes of a laughing imp.

items.Name: Silver Hand
items.Description: A false human hand, made of solid silver, with chips of ivory for fingernails.

items.Name: Herbal Pouch
items.Description: This worn leather pouch has a faint, musty odor. Much of the beadwork has fallen off, but there is still an ivory catch, and the lid features a large amethyst gem.

items.Name: Peg Leg
items.Description: A peg leg made of gilded wood, set with three large, cabochon-cut ovals of amber.

items.Name: Silver Arrowhead
items.Description: Normally used against lycanthropes, this shiny silver arrowhead was apparently never made into an arrow.

items.Name: Bodice Pin
items.Description: An ornamental bodice pin of polished brass, worked into the shape of a sleeping unicorn.  A chalcedony is inset to represent the alicorn, the legendary horn of the unicorn.

items.Name: Wall Hanging
items.Description: A huge tapestry worked in dyed wool.  The fabric consists of coarse threads on a background of scraped and sewn-together animal hides.  The hanging is mildewed, moth-eaten, dirty, and water-stained, yet the scene is still impressive.  A border of gold-colored entwining snakes en…

items.Name: Ornamental Shield
items.Description: A shield of beaten gold, bolted to a wooden underlay.  The gold is finely worked and enameled in a scene of an armored warrior riding rampant on horseback, brandishing a curved blade, while enemies flee toward the bottom of the shield.  Many castles and maidens are depicted with…

items.Name: Throwing Dagger
items.Description: Silver-plated steel, finely balanced, with plates of polished sardonyx on either side of the grip.
PropertiesDecoded: Shapechanger Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +1
Shapechanger Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1 Damage

items.Name: Ankus
items.Description: Used to herd beasts of burden, this gold-plated iron rod is hooked at one end. The other end is capped with a very large square-cut ruby.

items.Name: Mirror
items.Description: A mirror made of reflective, polished electrum, set in a silver frame.  The back panel of the mirror is chased in a design of a smiling female elf.  The mirror is designed without a handle.

items.Name: Tray
items.Description: A tray made from a giant scallop shell, gilded and affixed to a golden mock-claw base, which is adorned with four talons of black obsidian.

items.Name: Perfume
items.Description: A musky, violet-tinted perfume stored in a cut crystal bottle.  The bottle flares up from the base to wide facets along the side, then tapers to a thin neck.  The crystal stopper is sealed with wax.

items.Name: Harp
items.Description: This 40-string wooden harp has a dark finish, an ivory-inlaid bridge, and one end is carved to resemble the head of an elf, with zircons for eyes.  The name "Aurelin" is carved along the spine of the instrument in elegant common script.  This is a nonmagical replica of a legenda…

items.Name: Bronze Scepter
items.Description: A rod of bronze inlaid with silver circles and sixteen violet gems, topped with a huge, deep blue spinel.  The other end is a solid gold knob.  This item does not appear to be magical.

items.Name: Ring
items.Description: A slim band of steel, plated with electrum and set with two cabochon-cut opals, two cabochon-cut star sapphires, and a huge, central, black opal.

items.Name: Golden Ewer
items.Description: This flare-mouthed pitcher has two handles, and the outside is worked in an abstract, horizontal-curved design.

items.Name: Golden Platter
items.Description: A delicate platter of pierced and chased gold.  It is in good condition.

items.Name: Golden Crown
items.Description: A beautiful crown made of a thick, soft band of beaten gold, set with four large cabochon-cut aquamarines.

items.Name: Tapestry
items.Description: A large tapestry of wool and animal hair, with a few strands of spun gold in places.  It depicts three golden-haired maidens in skirts, standing in a moonlit garden beneath seven stars.  The object is in mediocre condition.

items.Name: Golden Bracelet
items.Description: A single bracelet made of heavy gold, and set with six blue-white diamonds.

items.Name: Clay Tile
items.Description: Made from baked and glazed clay, this tile is painted with an image of a swimming fish, with a white pearl set into the tile to represent the eye.

items.Name: Chainmail Shirt
items.Description: Made of a shining, meteoritic metal, this armor is well-oiled, triple-linked, and in top condition.

items.Name: Platemail Barding
items.Description: A set of blue steel plate armor designed for horses.  This set features rump skirt plates, chased in a floral design.  This barding is several centuries old, but still surpasses the quality of most modern-day smiths.

items.Name: Sarcophagus
items.Description: A casket of bronze, sheathed with electrum, in the shape of a sleeping female form.  The face of the effigy is fashioned of gold inlay.  Its eye sockets once held gems, but these are now missing.  The sarcophagus is empty.

items.Name: Gilded Stick
items.Description: A thick, gilded wooden stick, straight and smoothly cylindrical.  One end is capped with a gold, open-petaled flower, and the other end features a crescent moon of solid gold.  This wand is nonmagical.

items.Name: Red Ring
items.Description: A ring of red gold, beaten into a long knuckle-coil to resemble a miniature snake coiling around the wearer's finger.  Two tiny rubies are set into its head as eyes.

items.Name: Longsword
items.Description: A long sword of steel, plated with silver. A cabochon-cut piece of jet is attached at the hilt.
PropertiesDecoded: Shapechanger Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +1

items.Name: Toy Warrior
items.Description: An armored bronze warrior, with tiny, faceted turquoise eyes.  The shield of the warrior has a detailed silver inlay, but the blade of his sword has broken off and is missing.

items.Name: Ornamental Neckpiece
items.Description: A gold chain necklace attached by gold wire to six plates of electrum, shaped in matching pairs to cover the upper chest and neck of an adult humanoid.  Each pectoral plate is set with a large, faceted sapphire, and from these plates depend four emerald green, pyramid-cut, match…

items.Name: Brass Mug
items.Description: A brass mug, cut and chased in a broad ring of crashing waves, the engravings picked out in red enamel.  The handle of the mug has light-green jade inlays, carved in the images of djinn.

items.Name: Bale of Silk
items.Description: A rolled bale of dyed silk, bound with strips of leather and canvas. Some of the silk has turned black with rot, but most of the bale is still usable.

items.Name: Sickle
items.Description: A sickle consisting of a silver-plated blade and a gold-plated handle. The handle is worked into the configuration of a many-leaved branch.
PropertiesDecoded: Shapechanger Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1 Damage

items.Name: Black Mantle
items.Description: A black velvet mantle with black silk lining, adorned with beaded stars and geometric shapes.  Moonstones are set into the center of each star, 36 in all. The garment is in fine condition.

items.Name: Wolf Pelt
items.Description: This pelt of silver wolf fur has been cleaned, cured, and cut in the fashion of a winter overcloak.

items.Name: Aphrodisiac
items.Description:
A small, glass vial filled with a pale green mist.

Often touted as Love Potions, this simple charm, once unsealed, can make others more susceptible to the users wishes. Many hedge wizards create these items, though often their effectiveness of dubious nature. The aphrodisiac ha…
PropertiesDecoded: Charm Person (10) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Aroma of Dreams
items.Description:
A thin, fragile capsule of brass, banded in black.

These small brass capsules contain a powerful gas whose mere scent can send creatures into a somnolent state lasting for a short period. The gas is colorless and quick acting, spreading over a large area even in the absence of …

items.Name: Powder of the Black Veil
items.Description:
A small leather pouch containing a fine, black dust.

This light quenching powder was created by an assassin's guild called the Black Veil. When dispersed in the air, this fine powder quickly absorbs any light in a rather large area for a short period of time. This allowed the m…

items.Name: Powder of Coagulation
items.Description:
A small leather pouch containing a handful of crystalized, blue dust.

An alchemist of seeking a way to create a way to stop the blood flow of wounded soldiers, stumbled upon a combination of ingredients which worked beyond his wildest dreams. The powder, when applied using a pi…
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Light Wounds (5) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: Mugnosh
items.Description: When you ask the dwarven tavernkeeper what "Mugnosh" is, all you get is, "Drink. You like." It must have been funny, for he was laughing to himself as he turned back to his work.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Spirits Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Masterwork Studded Leather
items.Description: This colorful suit of dyed leather is of exceptional quality, set with studs of polished bronze to lend additional protection to the wearer.  Despite the fact that such metal is of inferior quality to steel, the quality of the suit is such that it actually provides superior prot…

items.Name: Nap Time
items.Description: Nap time arrows have the chance of putting their targets magically to sleep.

items.Name: Light Crossbow
items.Description: This light crossbow looks like it may have been a masterwork weapon, but it has been heavily damaged and likely would not prove very effective unless repaired.

items.Name: Necklace of Adaptation
items.Description: This necklace wraps its wearer in a shell of fresh air, making him immune to any type of fog/gas based spell.
PropertiesDecoded: Immunity: Specific Spell Cloud of Bewilderment

items.Name: Necromatic Regeneration
items.Description: Use this skill on a corpse to heal yourself, also notice depending on what race the creature is that you use it on depends on the bonus to your abilities.

items.Name: Neddah's Garb
items.Description: These bright clothes are well made, designed as an imitation of the style worn by the famous elven bard Neddah of Moonshae.  "Imitation is the sincerest form of flattery," the merchant tells you.  Unfortunately, this version lacks the subtle magical powers of the original garmen…

items.Name: Negate Damage +1
items.Description: Negate damage rings have magically enhanced to absorb some of the damage suffered by the wearer.

items.Name: Nerve Herbs
items.Description: These herbs when chewed provide a quick temporary boost to one's manual dexterity by quickening the reflexes.
PropertiesDecoded: Cat's Grace (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Netherese Amulet
items.Description: Strange Ruins abound in the many forgotten corners of Faerun.  Who can say how this artifact came to be where it was found?

items.Name: Nightcreeper's Cloth
items.Description: This suit of padded armor is clearly of masterwork make.  While it doesn't provide as much protection against attacks as a suit of armor, it has been designed to move smoothly and silently with the wearer, blending with the shadows and increasing a skilled stalker's chances to g…

items.Name: Night Death
items.Description: Crafted by the Mulhorandi followers of Set, Brother of Serpents and Father of Jackals;  these weapons have found great use by his minions in their ongoing attempts to thwart the plans of both Horus-Re and Osiris.
PropertiesDecoded: Good Damage Bonus vs. Alignment Group 2 Damage
Lawful Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Lawful Neutral Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Neutral Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Night Hunter
items.Description: Crafted by followers of Shevarash, the Black Archer; These bows see much usage in the hands of those who, like their deity, have sworn neither to laugh nor smile until Lolth and her foul followers are destroyed.
PropertiesDecoded: Evil Attack Bonus vs. Alignment Group +1
Chaotic Evil Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Chaotic Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Chaotic Neutral Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Night Strike
items.Description: Obviously of drow make, this blade bears the dark, mask symbol of Vhaeraun, the Masked Lord.

items.Name: Nightwind
items.Description: Originally created by followers of Shaundakul for their journeys of exploration, many of these blades have now found favor among those who often fight fire using creatures.

items.Name: Nimblefingers Gloves
items.Description: These masterfully tailored gloves of supple leather have soft cotton pads on the fingertips, aiding "detail work" without sacrificing tactile awareness or range of motion.

items.Name: Notched Dagger
items.Description: This dagger has various notches strategically placed about the blade. When used correctly, this dagger has the ability to catch incoming blows from bladed weapons.

items.Name: Nuts
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Dagger +1
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Dagger +2
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Dagger +3
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Nightsky of The Realms
items.Description:
On a clear night, numerous constellations can be observed in the sky over the realms, most with the naked eye, though some require magical divinations to be seen clearly.

The westen sky is marked by two "fuzzy" clusters of blue-white stars, which appear as two side-by-side cres…

items.Name: The Chalice of Serpents, Part 1
items.Description: For years, tavern-talk in the Western Heartlands of the Realms settled on the subject of an ancient, nigh-forgotten "God of Gold" and his holy chalice -- talk that grows very guarded around priests, especially clerics of Waukeen. Few have heard of such a deity or want to know of…

items.Name: The Chalice of Serpents, Part 2
items.Description: After warning patrons of the tavern that a snake will magically appear among them, Darvith Raldemarr calmly explains that before he takes the lid off the chalice, the questioner should ask their question, perhaps concerning a future decision as to an investment or deed that migh…

items.Name: On Boareskyr Bridge
items.Description: This bridge over the Winding Water was first built by the famous adventurer Boareskyr. Over the centuries, several bridges have stood here, the most recent built after the Time of Troubles. For most of those years, a "temporary" tent trading city has stood hard by the river cros…

items.Name: The Green Orb of Dragonkind
items.Description: Little is known about the true origin of the Orbs of Dragonkind, but according to legend Corellon Larethian appeared to elfkind soon after they began to unlock the secrets of magic. He bequeathed upon the elves five orbs of great power that would give them the necessary might to…

items.Name: The Lost Rings of Mhzentul
items.Description: The Seven Lost Rings of Mhzentul contain magics of great power. Legends have spoken often of them since the death of their maker, but their locations have rarely been more than a matter of colorful rumor. Mhzentul was a powerful, respected mage who perished at the battle of the …

items.Name: Lady Gemcloak
items.Description: Until the night of the dragon duel, many citizens of Mirabar, longtime mining capital of the Sword Coast North, were unaware that they'd acquired a dragon protector. It was a still, damp evening in spring of the year 1370 DR. The proprietors of the Watchful Axe alehouse were jus…

items.Name: Legend of The Lost Folk
items.Description:
Once upon a time, the Lost Folk wandered in primeval ice age northern land. They had grown with a host of gods. Some of their deities were benign, others were viscous and others an ambiguous blend. All reflected the world in which the Lost Folk lived.
The Lost Folk hunted like t…

items.Name: On Hills Edge
items.Description: Hill's Edge is a small city in Sunset Vale, close to the Goblin Marches and the Zhentarim stronghold of Darkhold. Hill's edge economy is founded on three things-sheep, caravans, and hunting. It is a rough and tumble frontier town, virtually every adult in the city has at least a…

items.Name: The Rise And Fall of Window Tax, Part 1
items.Description: Now it came to pass in the Year of the Unstrung Harp, when the shadow of the so-called "Devil Dragon" fell upon the land of Cormyr, that there was much fear in Suzail. After a brief flurry of war-related importations of armor and weaponry, trade in the city fell sharply. Many fo…

items.Name: The Rise And Fall of Window Tax, Part 2
items.Description: Culthorp's original draft Coincall was modified slightly by his superior, Master Clerk of Levies Asmarla Sundtree, whose cutting remarks earned her the nickname "Old Iceknife." She deemed "go-forth" collections of levy monies from nonpaying citizens shouldn't be a duty of the ov…

items.Name: Dawntree, Part 1
items.Description:
Wider Faerûn doesn't know it yet, but a few members of the youngest generation of elves are attempting something different from the prevalent pursuits of their kin over the last thousand years or so. They're trying to found a new elven kingdom.
Younglings of every race and backg…

items.Name: Dawntree, Part 2
items.Description:
Sages expect a new kingdom to be founded by a heroic war-leader, or perhaps a tyrannical mage or overpriest commanding armies of scuttling servile minions, but by four green younglings with, as elves would say: "Stars shining right through their eyes"?
In most intelligent races …

items.Name: Dawntree, Part 3
items.Description:
The dream of Dawntree couldn't have begun without Tasar Taurntyrith, but it would almost certainly have never been more than one elf's heart-full dream if not for Tasar's friends.
Rauvelore ("Rauve") Bhephel was born in the Year of Burning Steel to Suedlaurma and Vlorn Bhephel, …

items.Name: Dawntree, Part 4
items.Description: Ormsiir Mrhulaedir gently refused to answer his son's excited questions about nocturnal trips and meetings, but just knowing his father slipped out to meet with powerful folk in secrecy, to do things that mattered, stirred something in Oenel. He knew he needed to do such things,…

items.Name: Legends of The Stonelands
items.Description: Lying north of Cormyr is an area surrounded by many stories and legends. Many are its dangers, ranging from orcs and other Border Raiders to Zhentarim to dragons, but the Purple Dragoons of Cormyr are trying to patrol parts of it (as Cormyr claims the area). This wild region has…

items.Name: On Sanctuary
items.Description: The Misty Wood could be glimpsed from the edge of the High Moor and the trees looked cool and inviting. Onassin couldn't wait to be underneath the emerald shelter of the leaves. The ride had been long and treacherous for the moors were still rife with trolls and orcs to name onl…

items.Name: On Scornubel
items.Description: Scornubel, the Caravan City, is a huge, unwalled open city set on the north shore at the confluence of the Chionthar and the River Reaching. It is an unwalled town buzzing with continual activity, and a large number of pack animals, wagons, and symbols of merchant and trading co…

items.Name: The Red Sashes
items.Description: The Sashes were founded in 280 Northreckoning (1312DR) by the retired sellsword (and, some say, masked Lord of Waterdeep) Durnan, in response to blatant disregard for the Watch and the Laws that had grow common in the poorer areas of the city, especially Dock Ward. The Sashes we…

items.Name: Swords of The Smoking Fog
items.Description:
The Swords of the Smoking Fog are an adventuring group that operates mainly in the Dalelands, Cormyr, and the Moonsea. They take their name from the Smoking Frog, a renovated inn in Deepingdale, on the Eastway near Highmoon, that is their main base. 

The Swords began their care…

items.Name: The Broken Tower
items.Description: This ruin was once the home of Oenrune of the Ninespells, a Tethyrian archmage who lived several hundred years ago. He wound up on the losing end of a battle for the Tethyrian throne, and fled north to escape his enemies. He built this tower in the forest of The Wealdath, and wa…

items.Name: The Island Realm of Lantan
items.Description: "Ah, yes, the land of Gond. Contraptions and metal devices and little lights and whirling sparks and hammering at workbenches everywhere. Too many blasts and crashes to be entirely safe, but I like it. Sunny and gently rolling hills, farms everywhere with berry bushes where they…

items.Name: Arveiaturace The White Wyrm
items.Description: The inquisitive (not to mention foolish) explorations of the famous traveler and author Volo, filtered through Elminster, have yielded details of another dragon of the North: Arveiaturace the White Wyrm, known to sailors and minstrels alike as Iceclaws, thanks to her habit of dr…

items.Name: Circle of Vehlaar, Part 1
items.Description:
At the height of the summer season, Scornubel is ripe with the pungent odor from the fish market, mingled with the smells of unwashed workers and the caravan animals crowded into the streets between the warehouses, inns, and festhalls.
I wasn't going to spend more time in this c…

items.Name: Circle of Vehlaar, Part 2
items.Description:
The battle that followed was short and brutal. The three warriors of the Silver Stake were quite skilled. However, they clearly did not know whom they were facing.
I warned them to leave the shop peacefully if they wanted to live. Their response was lightning fast: The half-elve…

items.Name: Circle of Vehlaar, Part 3
items.Description:
"Do you mind if I join you at the fire," asked the wizard, pointing one of his wands at me, as he slid the other into a leather sheath that hung from his belt.
"How can I refuse?" I replied coldly.
He offered me a smile and took a seat next to Arahnar, who still sat with her mus…

items.Name: Circle of Vehlaar, Part 4
items.Description: "Arahnar," I said, trying to get her attention. She'd barely finished undressing before she began transforming to her full wolf aspect, a sleek black-furred creature almost as large as a bear. "Be careful or that wound on your arm-well, your leg-will open up again. Calm down. Wa…

items.Name: Circle of Vehlaar, Part 5
items.Description:
"So," Arahnar said. "How many times do you think we should get this ring recharged before we kill him?"

items.Name: Garb
items.Description: A must for the agile warrior or silent assassin, this cloth garb was made with noteable precision

items.Name: Robe
items.Description: Flowing with arcane contours, this fine cloth robe is the dress of choice for those who dabble in the magic arts.

items.Name: Cover
items.Description: Nice and thick for winter battles. If your enemy's blood won't keep you warm, this will!

items.Name: Toughened Leather
items.Description: Chewed and sunbaked countless times, this comfortable leather suit is deceptively protective for something that feels so comfortable to wear.

items.Name: Studded Leather
items.Description: Often underestimated, this fancy version of the leather garb not only looks cool, but offers added protection.

items.Name: Banded
items.Description: A little tougher than leather, a little lighter than chain, banded mail is the ideal solution for the support combateer.

items.Name: Breastplate
items.Description: Designed to protect the heart without weighing down the adventurer, this breastplate comes with abdominal air conditioning!

items.Name: Chain
items.Description: This mail, while a little noisy is surprisingly light.

items.Name: Half-plate
items.Description: Often refered to as a 'poor man's plate', this heavy armor will do the job while you save your coppers for a suit of wonderful full-plate.

items.Name: Plate
items.Description:
The staple armor for tanks and frontline warriors, this full plate will stop (most) arrows and protect you from crushing blows. 

Note: be careful not to get your head cleaved off.

items.Name: Battleaxe
items.Description: Slightly smaller and lighter than its twin the greataxe, this sturdy balanced weapon has the capability to cleave entire bodies in half. The largest pools of blood on the battlefield are usually the result of a rather nasty battleaxe wound.

items.Name: Belt 1
items.Description: Sometimes used to denote rank or status of martial standing, belts are one's primary means of holding up one's pants!

items.Name: Belt 2
items.Description: Sometimes used to denote rank or status of martial standing, belts are one's primary means of holding up one's pants!

items.Name: Boots 1
items.Description: These boots were made for fightin' and that just what they'll do. Hopefully these boots won't someday stomp all over you!

items.Name: Club
items.Description: A prehistoric mating tool that somehow found it's way to the battlefield. Clubs can deliver a nasty blow to the head but are practically useless against the bodys of well armed opponents. Spikes were added to the head of the club to increase its effectiveness, but nontheless, th…

items.Name: Dagger
items.Description: Often underestimated, the dagger is a lethal weapon in the hands of a skilled fighter. Popular among assassins and rogues for its propensity to kill quickly and silently, the dagger is definitely the weapon of choice for the silent killer.

items.Name: Two-Bladed Sword
items.Description: A popular orc weapon, the double-bladed sword is more intimidating than it is effective.

items.Name: Double Axe
items.Description: These versatile weapons, while very impractical on the battlefield, make for great boat anchors or main-poles for the pitching of tents in overnight camps. Very few can wield these ridiculous weapons effectively, though those who can are greatly respected and feared.

items.Name: Dire Mace
items.Description: Bulky and feasome, this huge weapon is often wielded by equally hulking figures. Slow and cumbersome yet absolutely devestating, the dire mace is not a weapon you want to be critted by.

items.Name: Greataxe
items.Description: This formidible axe is the favoured weapon of barbarians and strength fighters. Its carefully balanced bladed head is conducive to a myriad of martial maneuvers allowing fighters to marry its deadly power with formidible precision. Sustaining a critical hit on the wrong end of t…

items.Name: Halberd
